profile.headline: Software Engineer, Software Engineering Leader
profile.summary:
Experienced Senior Technologist with an extensive track record of hands-on development and effective leadership. Proven enterprise-class application architecture expertise in Java, Python AI/LLM, Node JS, Typescript, C#, Spring/EE, JMS/MQ, REST, SQL and a variety of other languages and tools. Particularly skilled at delegating and empowering teams to achieve exceptional results. Data-driven and action-oriented, with a passion for continuous improvement and retrospectives. Seeking a challenging opportunity to create impactful technology solutions. Specialties include Agile, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, and a wide range of cloud and database technologies. Strong leadership abilities in policy, budgeting, strategic planning, and team development.

Professional skills word cloud: 
Java, C#, Node JS, Typescript, Python, LLM, Agentic AI, Spring, J2EE, JMS/MQ, REST, SQL, SOAP, JSON, CI/CD, PHP, C, C++, JS, React, Node, HTML/CSS, Mobile and embedded Android, JUnit, Groovy, Cucumber, multithreaded, UrbanCode Deploy, Openshift, Docker, Azure DevOps, Jira, Aha!, Jenkins, Rally, IntelliJ, Azure Cloud, Amazon Web Services, Heroku, VM Ware, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Terraform, Veracode, SonarCube, Helm

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
* Lead software engineer for LLM/AI telephony systems (Python, TypeScript) 
* Enterprise integrations: Azure, MS Dynamics, Nice/CxOne, Twilio and Cognigy
* Agentic harness development
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Node.js in Azure · C# · Microsoft Dynamics CRM · Interactive Voice Response (IVR) · Large Language Models (LLM)

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
* FHIR and Big Data (65 billion accessions) to power analytics and clinical solutions
* Event driven, transactional data pipelines, historical data aggregation pipelines, microservices
* Java Spring, UrbanCode Deploy, OpenShift, Kubernetes
* AWS cloud, Azure cloud
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · Spring Framework · Microservices

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
* Led building/supporting monolithic and microservice client solutions that processed nearly a billion dollars in marketing incentives in 2022
* Responsible for daily team activities, performance, mentoring, coaching, career guidance, budgets 
* Company wide rearchitecture of SDLC processes and consolidation into Azure DevOps, later Jira 
* Established consistent Agile patterns, Azure training and Team Agreements
* Established consistent organization metrics and dashboards
* Founded Software Engineering COP
* Activist for continual improvement through Retrospective, Agile, Data Driven

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
* Led overhaul of Allscripts Touchworks EHR product core and DICOM
* Outspoken proponent for Agile patterns, SAFe
* Established test automation practices
* Responsible for daily team activities, appraisal, mentoring, coaching, career guidance, budgets

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
* Led team for developing realtime distributed HL7 intake, later ML/AI analytics over REST teams
* Hybridized Data Science and engineer teams to rapidly produce Big Data analytics on REST
* Built and supported distributed, realtime, HL7 clinical data intake system
* 100% test automation and CI/CD
* Temporarily led 5 additional teams (50) to teach new hires CI/CD and SMART on FHIR
* Activist for Agile patterns
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · JavaScript · Spring Framework · Microservices

positions.title: Software Engineer, Engineering Manager, Director, VP of Engineering
positions.description:
* Built complex Marketing CRM for managing advertising assets
* Built SaaS applications for business enablement
* Built and maintained ad delivery networks serving billions of ads per year
* Created test automation that checked over 15 million data points per run
* Replaced legacy applications with modern technology while maintaining business continuity
* Redesigned departments, job roles, career paths; gave career guidance
* Roadmaps, budgets, individual and departmental performance, department policy
* Load and stress testing N-tier applications for large audiences
* Waterfall and Agile methods
